title: Intersection of Two Linked Lists
constraints: Lists are acyclic; intersection means shared node identity, not equal values.
inputFormat: listFixture = [prefixA, prefixB, sharedTail]. The runner builds separate prefix nodes and one shared tail, then passes headA and headB. An empty sharedTail means no intersection.
outputFormat: Return the first node shared by both lists, or null. Return the node itself, not its value or a copy. The runner verifies identity and unchanged input lists, then displays its value.
